sections.body: Don't stop at reading the stories. Carry the visuals everywhere you go. Download our exclusive high-resolution wallpaper collection inspired by Tales 'N' Tells.

sections.title: minimum pages
paragraphs: We believe storytelling is drifting into the redundant. Tales 'N' Tells is an intervention, squick digest narratives delivered through sequential art. We respect your time, but we demand your focus.
sections.quote: It's not about how long it takes to read. It's about how long it stays with you.

sections.title: Paper Pages.
sections.body: Whether you crave the feel of pages in your hand or the freedom of reading digitally, your copy of Tales 'N' Tells is just a purchase away. Find us at our partner comic book shops or grab the digital edition instantly.
